html:
Hannibal was a Carthaginian general who led the war against Rome in the Second Punic War. He was born in 247 BCE and is counted among the greatest commanders in history.

He was the son of Hamilcar Barca, who fought Rome in the first war and then built a Carthaginian domain in Spain. Ancient writers say Hamilcar made the boy swear never to be a friend of Rome.

  • In 221 BCE he took command in Spain, and in 219 BCE he besieged Saguntum, an ally of Rome, which started the war.
  • In 218 BCE he crossed the Alps into Italy with an army and elephants.
  • He won at the Trebia, at Lake Trasimene and at Cannae, where he destroyed a much larger Roman army.

But Rome would not give in, and he could not take the city. He fought in Italy for fifteen years until he was called home in 203 BCE. Scipio beat him at the Battle of Zama in 202 BCE. He later led reforms in Carthage, then fled east to the Seleucid king Antiochus III. Hunted by Rome, he took poison in Bithynia, between 183 and 181 BCE.
sum: Hannibal was a Carthaginian general who led the war against Rome in the Second Punic War. He was born in 247 BCE and is counted among the greatest commanders in history.
